spec2def(rsaenh.dll rsaenh.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB NO_PRIVATE_WARNINGS)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# rsaenh.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/rsaenh-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(rsaenh_shims OBJECT handle.c implglue.c rsaenh.c)
target_link_libraries(rsaenh_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register symcrypt libmsvcrt libcrypt32 libadvapi32 libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(rsaenh_shims)
add_cargo_module(rsaenh rsaenh-cargo rsaenh.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS rsaenh_shims psdk)
